title: Silent Hill 2

custody.condition: Account-bound license on the archive Steam account. No physical media is part of this accession.

curatorNotes: Reserved for curator writing on the 2024 Silent Hill 2 remake as the archive’s contemporary digital counterpart to the PlayStation 2 reference copy.
collectionNotes: Digital ownership confirmed via Steam. No physical edition is held for this accession. Official cover artwork has been entered from Steam library art. The North American PlayStation 2 Silent Hill 2 retail disc remains a separate physical filing.

preservation.playableOn: Windows PC through Steam under archive custody
preservation.compatibility: Continued access requires the archive account and Steam’s ongoing support for the title.
preservation.concerns: As with other account-bound Steam holdings: platform dependency, policy change, and the absence of a retained offline installer.
preservation.knownRevisions: Bloober Team remake released on Steam October 7, 2024. This accession records the licensed digital remake and does not replace the North American PlayStation 2 Silent Hill 2 reference copy (LIB-0044).
preservation.availability: Playable from the archive Steam library for as long as that license and storefront path remain intact.

connections.futureReview: Reserved for future critical writing in Bloodsoaked Media.

stewardshipHistory.note: Steam library artwork filed under the Library accession path.
Catalog identity, authority references, and digital-holding documentation aligned for publication.
Digital accession curated from Steam custody and set to Catalogued · Permanent Record.

synopsis: Bloober Team’s Silent Hill 2 remake on Steam — retained as a permanent digital holding alongside the PlayStation 2 original.
